verdict.rationale: Google documents a first-party OpenAI-compatibility layer letting existing OpenAI SDK code point at Gemini with a 3-line update, using the same OpenAI Python/TypeScript libraries and REST endpoint, which directly satisfies the migration/adapter story. This is backed by official docs across multiple locales, indicating it's a stable, prominent feature rather than a footnote. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation that the OpenAI-compat shim works flawlessly across advanced features (e.g., function calling, streaming) rather than just basic text generation.
